mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (sender_code, sender_name, sender_role, receiver_code, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{senderCode}, #{senderName}, #{senderRole}, #{receiverCode}, #{content}, 0, COALESCE(#{createTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE (sender_code = #{userCode1} AND receiver_code = #{userCode2}) OR (sender_code = #{userCode2} AND receiver_code = #{userCode1}) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT sender_code FROM chat_message WHERE sender_role = 'customer' ORDER BY sender_code
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE sender_code = #{senderCode} AND sender_role = 'customer' AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE is_read = 0 AND sender_role = 'customer'
